manual.note: Honda 2011 CR-V Owner's Manual (unlinked PDF, 446 pp; footer 31SWA640). Oil p.351, viscosity p.349, US tire-pressure chart p.371, battery p.364, towing p.329. Printed page = PDF page - 6.

oilCapacity.value: 2.4L 4-cylinder (K24Z): 4.4 US qt (4.2 L) with filter, 4.2 US qt (4.0 L) without
oilCapacity.unverifiedNote: 2WD and 4WD use the same engine and the same fill. No other engine was offered in this market.

oilViscosity.value: Honda Genuine Motor Oil 0W-20 or API Premium-grade 0W-20 detergent oil

batteryGroup.value: 12 V; the manual lists 36 AH/5 HR, 38 AH/5 HR, 45 AH/20 HR or 47 AH/20 HR depending on trim (no BCI group number printed)
batteryGroup.note: Honda prints reserve-capacity AH figures, not a BCI group size.

tpmsReset.note: this edition prints no calibrate/reset procedure; the system is checked by the low-pressure indicator only

tires.note: The US tire-pressure chart prints 30 psi front/rear for 225/65R17 102T. The combined US/Canada specifications table (p.365) also lists a 16-inch 215/70R16 100S LX row at 32 psi; that LX fitment belongs to the Canadian line-up, and this page publishes the US 17-inch figure. Check the door-jamb label on a 16-inch car.
